name: Rankatsu!
source:
An average guy struggles for two years after being downsized from his job. Now a freeter barely making ends meet, every day is a bummer, until one day his friend brings home two girls for an orgy. This is the "king game", in which he lords over the girls like indentured servants. His life will never be the same.

Take the first step to a new and better life.

For the first time in years, he's ready to put effort into things again.

Rankatsu! means "rankou katsudou", or promiscuous activity.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ124691.html/]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一名平平无奇的男子在遭公司裁员后苦苦挣扎了两年，如今沦为勉强糊口的自由打工族，每天都过得憋屈窝囊——直到某天，好友带了两名少女回家开起了乱交派对。在这场“国王游戏”里，他如同使唤卖身契奴仆一般对少女们颐指气使，人生也就此迎来了翻天覆地的转变。

迈出通往崭新美好生活的第一步吧。

时隔多年，他终于再次燃起了全力以赴的干劲。

标题“乱活！”意为“乱交活动”。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ124691.html/]DLsite英文版[/url]]
